review_scope: Side-by-side native Vulkan checks for the 23 installed physical surface views in the published V2 packet. Review covers material visibility and continuity. Dark or obstructed angles retain their stated limits. These views do not qualify optical repair or artistic presentation.

images.observation: Table, wall opening, companion and floor treatment match the baseline view. The pooled highlight on the surface remains visible.
Curtain grain, tile joints and the circular light footprint match the baseline framing. The texture remains visible around the beam.
Resident, window trim, shelving and floorboards remain in frame with the expected surface separation.
Window, chair, table, wall return and floorboard pattern remain clearly defined in the same view.
Cabinet, sink and countertop shapes remain distinct. The irregular reflection at the back wall is present in both takes.
Boiler face, gauge, upper pipes and base silhouette remain mounted. The wall and floor remain dark as in the baseline.
Shelf boards, chair rails and the adjacent doorway retain the same material reading and visible outlines.
Wall tile grout, exposed service strip and cistern edges remain visible. Light falloff differs slightly between captures.
The dark close view mostly shows brick, as on main. The visible brick courses remain coherent. The framing limits inspection of other fittings.
Hinged cover, wordless dial fronts, wall-service edge and conduit are still distinguishable. The gloss sampled on the cover has shifted.
The frame still shows the brassy rail and floor grid. Furniture obstructs most of the body in both takes, so this view supports nearby surfaces.
The shelf, small red object and photograph are present. The dark framing affords limited detail.
The same overhead soffit, framed items and shelf are mounted. The low dark angle remains limited for character review.
Slot labels, metal faces, wood paneling and bench retain their visible separation in the dim take.
Section ribs, pipe edge, window treatment and the neighboring clock keep their fitted silhouettes and material response.
Guard rails and their junctions, roof door surround, wall lettering and ceiling fixtures hold their baseline shapes.
Tank body, leg feet, ladder guard and roof trim remain resolved against the city background. Sky lighting varies slightly.
Housing edges, illuminated control face and adjacent noticeboard retain the visual separation seen on main.
Regular grout and cistern edges remain cleanly rendered. The brightest reflection and shadow edge move between takes.
The color patches in the illuminated residue remain distinct from the surrounding floorboards and radiator.
The emergent form keeps its relief and material highlights under the companion lamp against the coated floor.
Kettle, toaster ridges, crumbs and counter surfaces remain distinct. The brighter take shows more warm reflection on the appliance.
The casing and surrounding wall treatment match their baseline placement. The dark exposure limits fine detail, with a small metal highlight visible in the candidate.
